description_en: Queries the trend of queries per second (QPS)
description_zh: 查看请求命中的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-peak-trend --start-timestamp 1665331200 --interval 300 --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePeakTrend

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The time interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer multiple of 60
parameters.help_zh: 时间间隔，单位：秒。取值为60的整数倍
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The protected object for which you want to query the QPS trend, such as a domain name
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AclSum.description_en: The number of requests protected by the ACL module. This includes requests that are monitored and blocked
AclSum.description_zh: ACL防护数量，包括观察命中量和拦截量

AntiScanSum.description_en: The number of requests protected by the scan protection module. This includes requests that are monitored and blocked
AntiScanSum.description_zh: 扫描防护数量，包括观察命中量和拦截量

CcSum.description_en: The number of requests protected by the CC protection module. This includes requests that are monitored and blocked
CcSum.description_zh: CC防护数量，包括观察命中量和拦截量

Index.description_en: The ordinal number for the time point, sorted in chronological order
Index.description_zh: 时间序号，按时间先后顺序排序

WafSum.description_en: The number of requests protected by the web attack protection module. This includes requests that are monitored and blocked
WafSum.description_zh: 正则防护数量，包括观察命中量和拦截量
